card.name: Just before drug names starting c or r
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a short word (comma, 'e.g.,', 'and', 'of') or a split-off first letter such as 'c' or 'Rep', right before a drug name or section start like cimetidine, cyclophosphamide or Reproduction.

modes.label: Comma or 'and' before a drug
modes.description: Separator in a list of chemotherapy or interacting drugs, just before the next drug name.

modes.label: After e.g. or i.e.
modes.description: The punctuation of 'e.g.,' or 'i.e.,' that introduces example drugs or details.

modes.label: Start of a word beginning Rep or c
modes.description: The first piece of a word like Reproduction or cimetidine at the start of a sentence or example.

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model to continue with a word starting with a particular letter group, such as 'c' or 'r', but the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the spot just before a drug or heading word such as cimetidine, cyclophosphamide or Reproduction begins.
